title: Industry Reactions to Major Outages and AI Patching Debate: Feedback Friday
description: A series of major technology outages in the United States have raised concerns about the operational risks associated with AI-accelerated patching. Experts highlight that the rapid pace of patch deployment, driven by AI discovery of vulnerabilities, compresses patch cycles and increases the risk of instability and outages. The outages were attributed to software defects, hardware upgrades, and routine maintenance, with no evidence of cyberattacks. Industry feedback emphasizes the need for tested rollback plans, clear ownership of patching decisions, and minimizing changes in urgent patches to reduce risk.
